pins.name: BTS bus stop at Hyangho Beach, Jumunjin (향호해변 BTS 버스정류장)
pins.desc: Hyangho Beach, Jumunjin-eup, Gangneung. The lone bus stop on the sand is the cover of the album You Never Walk Alone (2017), rebuilt as a photo zone; the Spring Day jacket photos were taken on the Jumunjin breakwater nearby. Free, open all hours; busiest at sunrise.

pins.name: Maengbang Beach, Butter jacket (맹방해수욕장)
pins.desc: Geundeok-myeon, Samcheok. The beach of the Butter (2021) jacket and concept photos; the parasols, sunbeds and surfboard props are kept as a photo zone on the sand. Free.

pins.name: Gimyujeong Station, the Chuncheon stop (김유정역)
pins.desc: Gyeongchun line, Sindong-myeon, Chuncheon; the old station building next door is preserved. On fan itineraries as the Chuncheon stop: In the SOOP season 1 (2020) was shot at a private lakeside villa in Chuncheon that cannot be visited, so this station and the rail bike are what fans come to. No BTS shoot is documented at the station itself.

pins.name: Phoenix Pyeongchang, In the SOOP 2 (휘닉스 평창)
pins.desc: Taegi-ro 174, Bongpyeong-myeon, Pyeongchang. The resort where In the SOOP season 2 (2021) was filmed; the resort opened the house and grounds used in the show to visitors in 2022 (Kyunghyang, Aug 2022). Check with the resort what is still open.

pins.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace, Tonight Show stage (경복궁 근정전·경회루)
pins.desc: Sajik-ro 161, Jongno-gu. For NBC's The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon "BTS Week" (September 2020) the group performed IDOL in front of Geunjeongjeon throne hall and Mikrokosmos at Gyeonghoeru pavilion. Palace open 09:00–18:00 (to 17:00 Nov–Feb), closed Tuesdays, ₩3,000; free in hanbok.

pins.name: National Museum of Korea, Dear Class of 2020 (국립중앙박물관)
pins.desc: Seobinggo-ro 137, Yongsan-gu. The museum's halls and the view of N Seoul Tower from its steps were the set of the Dear Class of 2020 speech and performance (June 2020) and of a Seoul tourism film. Free; closed 1 January, Seollal and Chuseok days.

pins.name: Nodeul Island (노들섬)
pins.desc: Yangnyeong-ro 445, on the Han River under Hangang Bridge. Reported shooting site of the 2021 Season's Greetings photos and of a Seoul promotion video. Free; cafés, bookshop and lawns.

pins.name: Euljiro print alleys, around Euljiro 3-ga Station (을지로 인쇄골목)
pins.desc: The lanes of small print shops between Euljiro 3-ga and Chungmuro. Reported shooting site of the 2021 Season's Greetings. Naver has no entry for the alleys themselves, so this pin is the station; walk south from exit 10.

pins.name: Hakdong Park, trainee days (학동근린공원)
pins.desc: Gangnam-daero 140-gil 47, Nonhyeon-dong. The small park near the old Big Hit office where the trainees practised and rested; one of the stops of the Seoul BTS tour map by the Seoul Tourism Organization.

pins.name: Yujeong Sikdang, the trainee-days restaurant (유정식당)
pins.desc: Dosan-daero 28-gil 14, Nonhyeon-dong. The pork-grill diner where the members ate in their trainee years; the walls are covered with notes and goods from ARMY. Hours on Naver (checked 2026-10-30): weekdays 10:00–21:30, Sat–Sun 10:00–20:00, last order 25 min before. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-30.

pins.name: HYBE headquarters (하이브 용산 사옥)
pins.desc: Hangang-daero 42, Yongsan-gu, by Yongsan Station. The company building since 2021; no public tour, but the lobby café HYBE Insight area and the street outside are a fan meeting point.

pins.name: Seoul National University old pool, HYYH prologue (서울대 폐수영장)
pins.desc: Gwanak campus, Gwanak-ro 1. The abandoned outdoor pool on the campus is the empty pool of the HYYH on stage: prologue film (2015). Naver's entry is the campus pool; ask at the campus for the old pool, and respect that it is a university.

pins.name: Sungnyemun, Global Citizen Live (숭례문)
pins.desc: Sejong-daero 40. The gate was the backdrop of the Permission to Dance performance for Global Citizen Live (September 2021). Free, 09:00–18:00, closed Mondays.

pins.name: World Cup Bridge, Dynamite on the Tonight Show (월드컵대교)
pins.desc: The Han River bridge, then unopened, on which Dynamite was performed for The Tonight Show BTS Week (September 2020); the city allowed the shoot before the bridge opened (JoongAng). It is a road bridge: view it from Haneul Park or the riverside, do not walk on it.

pins.name: Achasan, Run BTS (아차산)
pins.desc: Gwangjin-gu, 287 m. An easy city hill with Han River views; on fan lists as a Run BTS filming place. Reported by fan tour lists and the press; HYBE does not confirm filming locations.

pins.name: Oil Tank Culture Park, Run BTS (문화비축기지)
pins.desc: Jeungsan-ro 87, Mapo-gu, next to World Cup Stadium. Old oil tanks turned into a culture park; on fan lists as a Run BTS filming place. Reported by fan tour lists and the press; HYBE does not confirm filming locations. Free, closed Mondays.

pins.name: Yeouido Hangang Park, BTS Festa 2023 (여의도한강공원)
pins.desc: Yeouido-dong-ro 330. The park and the river were the stage of the 10th-anniversary BTS Festa (17 June 2023) with the fireworks over the Han. Free.

pins.name: Iryeong Station, Spring Day (일영역)
pins.desc: Iryeong-ro 647beon-gil 25, Jangheung-myeon, Yangju. The closed station of the Gyoe-oe line where the Spring Day music video (2017) opens, with the members on the platform and the tracks. Free; the platform is open, the line is disused.

pins.name: Seohuri Forest, 2019 Season's Greetings (서후리숲)
pins.desc: Geobukbawi 1-gil 200, Seojong-myeon, Yangpyeong. A private birch forest and garden, the setting of the 2019 Season's Greetings photos. Entry fee; opening days change by season, check Naver.

pins.name: Yongin Daejanggeum Park, Daechwita (용인 대장금파크)
pins.desc: Yongcheon Drama-gil 25, Baegam-myeon, Yongin. The MBC period-drama set where Agust D (Suga) shot the Daechwita music video (2020). Open daily, about ₩9,500; the throne hall and the market street are the scenes.

pins.name: Jichuk train depot, Love Yourself: Her photos (지축차량기지)
pins.desc: Samsong-ro 300, Deogyang-gu, Goyang. A Seoul Metro depot where the Love Yourself 承 Her concept photos were taken (2017). Not open to the public; the pin is for the view from the road.

pins.name: Ueumdo, Spring Day outdoor scenes (우음도)
pins.desc: Songsan-myeon, Hwaseong, in the reclaimed Sihwa flats. On fan lists as the open-field scenes of Spring Day. Reported by fan tour lists and the press; HYBE does not confirm filming locations. Free, a bare landscape; bring water.

pins.name: Awon hanok, 2019 Summer Package (완주 아원고택)
pins.desc: Songgwangsuman-ro 516-7, Soyang-myeon, Wanju. A 250-year-old hanok moved from Jinju and set over a modern gallery; the 2019 Summer Package photos and shows were shot here. Day visitors pay for the gallery café (about ₩10,000, drink included); it is also a hanok stay.

pins.name: Jecheon airfield, Epilogue: Young Forever (제천 모산비행장)
pins.desc: Mosan-dong, Jecheon. The small grass airfield where the members ran down the runway in the Epilogue: Young Forever video (2016). Open ground, free.

pins.name: Saemangeum Seawall, Save ME (부안 새만금방조제)
pins.desc: The 33 km seawall between Buan and Gunsan; its reclaimed flats are where Save ME (2016) was danced. The Saemangeum exhibition hall park in Byeonsan-myeon has a photo zone with the view of Gyehwado and Seokbulsan from the video.

pins.name: Damyang Metasequoia Road, RM's trip (담양 메타세쿼이아길)
pins.desc: Damyang-eup. The 2 km avenue of metasequoias that RM visited on his own travels, after which fans followed; ₩2,000.

pins.name: Gwanbangjerim river forest (관방제림)
pins.desc: Gaeksa 7-gil 37, Damyang-eup. The 300-year-old embankment forest along the Damyang stream, 2 km from the metasequoia road, on RM's Damyang walk. Free.

pins.name: Gamcheon Culture Village, Jimin and Jungkook mural (감천문화마을)
pins.desc: Gamnae 2-ro 203, Saha-gu, Busan. The hillside village has a large mural of the two Busan members, Jimin and Jungkook, with queues of fans in front of it (Seoul Shinmun, June 2026). Free; the information centre sells the village map.

pins.name: Busan Citizens Park, the V road (부산시민공원)
pins.desc: Simingongwon-ro 73, Busanjin-gu. The park where V was photographed on a walk; the lane is sold by tour operators as the "V road". Free.

pins.name: V mural street at Daeseong Elementary, Daegu (대구 비산동 뷔 벽화거리)
pins.desc: Gukchaebosang-ro 426, Seo-gu, Daegu. The 60 m mural along the wall of V's old primary school in Bisan-dong, painted in December 2021 and extended in 2022, paid for by his Chinese fan club; "Borahae" is written in many languages along the top (Seoul Shinmun, May 2022). Next to Dalseong Toseong village.

pins.name: Suga mural lanes near Myeongdeok Station (대구 슈가 벽화거리)
pins.desc: Myeongdeok-ro 185, Nam-gu, Daegu. The lanes around Myeongdeok Station (the Mulbegi street) carry about ten murals painted in 2022 for the Daegu-born Suga. The pin is the station.

pins.name: Hwarang Hill, Gyeongju (경주 화랑의언덕)
pins.desc: Geoncheon-eup, Gyeongju. The grass hill with the big pine that became a photo spot after RM posted his visit. Reported by fan tour lists and the press; HYBE does not confirm filming locations. Free, open all hours.

pins.name: Cheomseongdae observatory (첨성대)
pins.desc: Gyeongju. The 7th-century stone observatory, on RM's Gyeongju trip and on every fan itinerary of the city. Free, lit at night.

pins.name: Gyeongjeong Port, HYYH prologue (영덕 경정항)
pins.desc: Gyeongjeong-ri, Chuksan-myeon, Yeongdeok. The small harbour and its breakwater structures are the seaside scenes of the HYYH on stage: prologue film (2015).

pins.name: Toilet at Hakdong Park (학동공원화장실)
pins.desc: Gangnam-daero 140-gil 47.

pins.name: Toilet at Gyeongbokgung, Gyeonghoeru (경복궁 경회루 개방화장실)
pins.desc: Inside the palace by the pavilion.

pins.name: Toilet at Gamcheon Culture Village (감천문화마을공중화장실)
pins.desc: Gamnae 2-ro 201, by the information centre.

pins.name: Toilet at Busan Citizens Park (부산시민공원화장실)
pins.desc: In the park.
